new.x: James Wilson presented India's first budget on 7 April 1860. Shanmukham Chetty presented the first budget of independent India (26 Nov 1947), Liaquat Ali Khan the 1947-48 interim budget, and Morarji Desai holds the record of 10 budgets.

new.s: The first budget of independent India was presented on 26 November 1947 by:

new.tq: Interim Govt = Liaquat; independent India = Chetty.

new.s: Fiscal deficit of the Union Government is best defined as:
o: Total expenditure minus total receipts excluding borrowings
Total expenditure minus tax revenue only
new.x: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure minus receipts excluding borrowings. Revenue expenditure minus revenue receipts is the revenue deficit; fiscal deficit minus interest payments is the primary deficit; subtracting only tax revenue ignores non-tax and non-debt capital receipts.
new.tq: FD = borrowing need; PD = FD - interest; RD = RE - RR.
